sections.text:
EXPERIENCES WORTH TRAVELLING FOR

Moments that stay with you.

Ancient sites, guided excursions, river days and Nubian hospitality.

DISCOVER EXPERIENCES
→
Temples & ancient sites
ABU SIMBEL

From the colossi of Ramses II to the island temple of Isis, the great monuments of the Nile.

Nubian villages
ASWAN

Colourful villages on the west bank and a culture all its own.

Guided excursions
GIZA

Private touring with local guides who bring each site to life.

Felucca sailing

The Nile at the pace of the wind.

Local cuisine

Traditional Nubian food, shared around the table.

Boutique stays
ANAKOB · MANGO GUESTHOUSE

Distinctive places to rest on and beside the Nile, each with its own Nubian character.

sections.text:
ANAKOB · ASWAN’S FIRST FLOATING BOUTIQUE HOTEL

The magic of Nubia, from the Nile.

Anakob is the newest, and the first, boutique floating hotel in Aswan. It reflects Nubian art and culture with a trendy, modern and comfortable setup, and it was designed and positioned with the Nile view in mind: every bedroom looks out on the river, and the shared spaces have panoramic views in every direction.

DISCOVER ANAKOB
→
NILE-VIEW BEDROOMS
01
THE SUNDECK
02
A skylight for the southern sun
The skylight is fitted with a heat-reflective transparent film, positioned to let you enjoy the great sun of Upper Egypt without the soaring heat.
A sundeck shaped like a sail
The sundeck shade is made from a single piece of tensile fabric, with corners set at different levels to echo the sail of a traditional felucca.
Rooms made for the climate
Each room is designed with the warm climate in mind. Air conditioning, shutters and insulated walls keep it comfortable, even at the height of summer.

sections.text:
A NUBIAN HOME ON ELEPHANTINE ISLAND

Mango Guesthouse sits among the gardens of Elephantine Island, in the middle of the Nile at Aswan. It is a place for local hospitality and traditional Nubian food, and for experiencing the slower rhythm of island life.

Traditional Nubian food, shared.

Local, traditional Nubian food at Mango Guesthouse, on Elephantine Island.

Meals are served in a shaded courtyard where guests sit down together: one of the simplest and warmest ways to experience Nubian hospitality.

THE NUBIAN FOOD EXPERIENCE
→
LUNCH IN THE COURTYARD
MANGO GUESTHOUSE

images.alt: The Mango Guesthouse
Guests sharing a traditional Nubian lunch in the courtyard at Mango Guesthouse

sections.text:
ELEPHANTINE ISLAND

Life on the island.

Staying on Elephantine means stepping away from the bustle of Aswan while staying right in the middle of it.

I
An island in the Nile

Elephantine sits in the middle of the river opposite Aswan, a green island of gardens, palm trees and quiet lanes, reached by a short boat ride.

II
Nubian villages

The island is home to Nubian villages, where painted houses and everyday life carry on at their own unhurried pace.

III
Ancient Abu

At its southern tip lie the ruins of ancient Abu, one of the oldest settlements in Egypt, and one of the river’s historic Nilometers.

IV
Close to everything

From the island, Philae, the Nubian villages of the west bank and a felucca on the river are all within easy reach.

ASWAN AND ITS ISLANDS FROM ABOVE

pages.title: Nubian cuisine, Aswan | Syaha Tour

sections.text:
THE EXPERIENCE

Traditional Nubian Food at Mango Guesthouse

Some of the most memorable moments in Aswan happen around a table. At Mango Guesthouse on Elephantine Island, guests sit down together to traditional Nubian dishes in a shaded garden courtyard.

It is a simple, generous way to experience Nubian hospitality, and a lovely pause between temples.

COVERS

Traditional Nubian food
Mango Guesthouse, Elephantine Island

AT A GLANCE

DESTINATION
Aswan
LOCATION
Elephantine Island, Aswan
PRICE & TIMING
On inquiry

Rates and timings depend on your dates and group size. Send us an inquiry and we will come back to you with the details.

INQUIRE ABOUT THIS TOUR
